headlines.title: Forget Chasing the Biggest Yield. These 5 Dividend Stocks Have Something Better
headlines.summary: One of these five blue chips has sent shareholders a dividend check every single quarter since 1916, and that kind of staying power changes how you think about building retirement income from scratch.

headlines.title: How UPS’s Holiday RFID and Secure Delivery Push Will Impact United Parcel Service (UPS) Investors
headlines.summary: In early October 2026, UPS entered the holiday shipping season with plans to hire about 100,000 seasonal workers and rolled out new services including RFID-powered tracking, Protected Delivery PIN verification for high-value parcels, expanded pickup visibility, streamlined returns with Happy Returns, same-day and bulky delivery via Roadie, and limited-edition holiday packaging.

headlines.title: UPS (UPS) Stock Could Be 42% Undervalued Despite Holiday Hiring Cuts
headlines.summary: United Parcel Service has seen its share price fall well behind the wider market over the past few years, so the immediate question is whether the current US$94.13 price still lines up with the cash the business can generate. Recent moves to reshape its workforce and product mix put the focus squarely on how resilient UPS's cash flows really are. The stock has declined 37.

headlines.title: Why Is United Parcel Service (UPS) Adding Protected Delivery For 2026 Holidays?
headlines.summary: United Parcel Service (NYSE:UPS) announced new "Protected Delivery" PIN-based verification for high value shipments planned for the 2026 holiday season. The company outlined an expansion of RFID-powered package tracking to more sorting hubs and delivery routes ahead of its next peak period. UPS paired the security rollout with a global seasonal hiring plan for the 2026 year end rush, targeting additional staff across key markets.

headlines.title: United Parcel Service's Quarterly Earnings Preview: What You Need to Know
headlines.summary: United Parcel Service will release its third-quarter earnings later this month, and analysts anticipate a single-digit profit dip.

description: United Parcel Service, Inc., a package delivery and logistics provider, offers transportation and delivery services. It operates through two segments, U.S. Domestic Package and International Package. The U.S. Domestic Package segment offers time-definite delivery services for express letters, documents, packages and palletized freight through air and ground services. The International Package segment provides small package operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Canada and Latin America, and Asia. The company offers a range of guaranteed day- and time-definite international transportation services; day-definite services; cross-border ground package delivery; contract-only, e-commerce solutions for non-urgent, and cross-border shipments; and international service for urgent and palletized shipments. It also provides international air and ocean freight forwarding, contract logistics, customs brokerage and insurance, mail services, healthcare logistics, distribution, and post-sales services. United Parcel Service, Inc. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
